title: Woodes Unveils a Cinematic Masterpiece with 'Hibernation EP'
htmlContent:
Woodes(Instagram) is back with her most ambitious work yet, and it's nothing short of extraordinary. The "Hibernation EP" is an invitation to immerse yourself in the artist's unique musical realm, which has taken on a new, cinematic dimension. Woodes(YouTube), the latest release, offers listeners a 13-minute escape into a world filled with strings, brass, choirs, and Woodes's unparalleled artistry.

LINK TO THE EP: https://s.disco.ac/sawjlsjcgdmt

The EP opens with "Hibernate," an introspective track that beautifully captures the essence of years spent in lockdown. Like a bear emerging from its slumber, it gradually builds into a majestic symphony of voices, setting the stage for the grandeur that awaits.

The journey continues with "Don't Look Back," a percussive-driven anthem that exemplifies Woodes's dream of creating music for film and game trailers. It's a track that ignites the imagination, evoking images of epic battle scenes and high-energy action sequences.

"War Cry" stands as a powerful anthem for women, celebrating their unity and strength in the face of adversity. This track is not just a song but a call to arms, urging everyone to stand together and make a difference.

Finally, "Heavenly" takes a reflective turn, like the end of a film where a lone performer plays a lute, recounting the tale. It was born from the strength of the "War Cry" bridge, and it leaves you with a haunting sense of beauty and wonder.

For tickets to THE HIBERNATION TOUR: https://www.woodesmusic.com/

Hibernation EP is not just a collection of tracks; it's a 13-minute journey that you won't want to end. Woodes(TikTok) has once again proven her ability to craft musical experiences that are truly extraordinary. Don't miss this cinema.
